svg.title: Both assurance channels remain empty
svg.desc: Draw both assurance channels with empty receiving slots. The shared lack is a credible assurance, not proof the two parties seek identical commitments.

The shared lack is a credible assurance, not proof the two parties seek identical commitments.", "lettering": [ { "box": [ 0.58, 0.04, 0.38, 0.1158 ] }, { "box": [ 0.58, 0.1738, 0.38, 0.1158 ] }, { "box": [ 0.58, 0.3076, 0.38, 0.19740000000000002 ] } ], "lettering_mode": "manual", "nodes": [ { "asset": "outline-box", "box": [ 0.05775, 0.2397, 0.2193, 0.344619 ], "color": "steel", "focus": true, "label": "BOARD ASSURANCE", "label_box": [ 0.05775, 0.605205, 0.2193, 0.151423 ], "label_size": 18 }, { "asset": "outline-box", "box": [ 0.31275, 0.2397, 0.2193, 0.344619 ], "color": "steel", "focus": true, "label": "INSTITUTIONAL ASSURANCE", "label_box": [ 0.31275, 0.605205, 0.2193, 0.151423 ], "label_size": 18 }, { "asset": "boundary", "box": [ 0.29643, 0.0804, 0.00714, 0.7788 ], "color": "steel", "focus": true } ], "reconstructed": false, "shot": "split", "source": "
**Frame:** Both sides address a channel that would carry an assurance. Left waits on a board message; right waits on a standard, a commitment, or a rival's action. Both channels are drawn, and both are empty.

**Left dialogue — AGENT:**
> I will hold if the others hold.

**Right dialogue — INSTITUTIONAL ROLE:**
> We can slow if the field slows with us.

**Caption:**
> EACH ACTOR WANTS A GUARANTEE IT CANNOT CREATE ALONE.

**Provenance:** `compressed` + `invented` — neither line is a source quotation. The empty channel is the page's subject and must stay visible in every later panel.
